```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidypopgen)
library(grid)
library(resrepo)
```

This script repeats the steps in s01a_qc_merge to merge malagasy data, while retaining and ordering the genetic distance of SNPs, for ALDER analysis.

# Generate gen tibble

```{r}
if (file.exists(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full.gt"))) {
  madagascar <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full.gt"))
} else {
  madagascar <- gen_tibble("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full.bed", quiet = TRUE, valid_alleles = c("T", "G", "A", "C", "I"))
}

cat("Number of individuals:", nrow(madagascar), "\n")
cat("Number of loci:", count_loci(madagascar))
```


Our raw dataset has 713014 SNPs and 192 individuals

# Add metadata

```{r}
# Read in Pierron Malagasy metadata
pop_table <- read.table(path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2", "FID", "Population", "V5", "V6", "V7")

# Add "RR" to pop_table$IID
pop_table$IID <- paste0(pop_table$IID, "RR")

# Find Malagasy entries
pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table, pop_table$IID %in% madagascar$id & pop_table$V5 == "Madagascar")

# match up the ID's with pop table metadata
matching_m <- match(madagascar$id, pop_table_sub$IID)

madagascar$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$Population[matching_m], madagascar$population)
```

remove <- which(show_loci(madagascar)$allele_ref == "I")
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci(-all_of(c(remove)))
count_loci(madagascar)

# Update build

Add a section here with the biomart function/find a better way to do this?

First, new bim
```{r}
new_bim_no_NA <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/Madagascar_full_HG38.bim"), header = FALSE)
colnames(new_bim_no_NA) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2")

nrow(new_bim_no_NA)
new_bim_no_NA <- as_tibble(new_bim_no_NA)

# subset to only autosomes
new_bim_no_NA <- new_bim_no_NA %>% filter(chromosome %in% c(1:22))

# order by chromosome
new_bim_no_NA$chromosome <- as.integer(new_bim_no_NA$chromosome)
new_bim_no_NA <- new_bim_no_NA %>% arrange(chromosome, physical_pos)

# remove any entries where genetic_dist = 0
new_bim_no_NA <- new_bim_no_NA %>% filter(genetic_dist != 0)

# check for duplicated genetic_dist within each chromosome
duplicates <- new_bim_no_NA %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  group_map(~ duplicated(.x$genetic_dist))

dups <- unlist(duplicates)

# remove duplicates
new_bim_no_NA <- new_bim_no_NA %>% filter(!dups)

find_order <- function(x) {
  # store the first value in x$genetic_dist
  j <- x$genetic_dist[1]
  problematic <- c()

  for (i in 2:length(x$genetic_dist)) {
    if (x$genetic_dist[i] >= j) {
      j <- x$genetic_dist[i]
    } else {
      problematic <- c(problematic, x$snp_id[i])
    }
  }
  return(problematic)
}

# apply find_order to each chromosome
grouped_bim <- new_bim_no_NA %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  group_map(~ find_order(.x))

# remove problematic SNPs
remove <- unlist(grouped_bim)
new_bim_no_NA <- new_bim_no_NA %>% filter(!snp_id %in% remove)

# check sorting again
# new_bim_no_NA %>%
#  group_by(chromosome) %>%
#  group_map(~ is.unsorted(.x$genetic_dist)) #14 of 22 are still not sorted?
```


```{r}
# select only the loci with updated positions
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci_if(loci_names(genotypes) %in% new_bim_no_NA$snp_id)

# find matching indices
match_indices <- match(show_loci(madagascar)$name, new_bim_no_NA$snp_id)
matching_rows <- !is.na(match_indices)

# update position in gt
show_loci(madagascar)$position[matching_rows] <- new_bim_no_NA$physical_pos[match_indices[matching_rows]]

# update chromosome in gt
show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome <- as.character(show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome)
show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome[matching_rows] <- new_bim_no_NA$chromosome[match_indices[matching_rows]]

# update chr_int in gt
show_loci(madagascar)$chr_int <- as.integer(show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome)
count_loci(madagascar)

# update genetic distance in gt
show_loci(madagascar)$genetic_dist[matching_rows] <- new_bim_no_NA$genetic_dist[match_indices[matching_rows]]

# remove entries with genetic distance == 0
no_dist <- which(show_loci(madagascar)$genetic_dist == 0)
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci(-no_dist)

testthat::expect_false(is_loci_table_ordered(madagascar, error_on_false = FALSE, ignore_genetic_dist = FALSE))
```

# Merge the two datasets

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- rbind(madagascar, madagascar_p,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE, backingfile = resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_merge_master")
)

```

# Sort the order
```{r}
testthat::expect_false(is_loci_table_ordered(malagasy_merged, error_on_false = FALSE))
# reorder the loci
malagasy_merged <- gt_order_loci(malagasy_merged, use_current_table = FALSE, ignore_genetic_dist = FALSE)
```

# Filter the merged dataset

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% group_by(population)
loci_report_m <- qc_report_loci(malagasy_merged)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% ungroup()
```

# Loci

```{r}
to_keep <- which(loci_report_m$hwe_p > 0.01)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep))
count_loci(malagasy_merged)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% select_loci_if(loci_missingness(genotypes) < 0.01)
count_loci(malagasy_merged)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% select_loci_if(loci_maf(genotypes) > 0.025)
count_loci(malagasy_merged)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% select_loci_if(show_loci(genotypes)$chromosome %in% c(1:22))
count_loci(malagasy_merged)
```

# Indiv

```{r}
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <- qc_report_indiv(malagasy_merged, kings_threshold = 0.177)
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% ungroup()
malagasy_merged <- malagasy_merged %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)
nrow(malagasy_merged)
count_loci(malagasy_merged)
```

```{r}
gt_save(malagasy_merged, file_name = path_resrepo("data/intermediate/rbind_data/rbind_sort_dist/malagasy_merge_master_v2"))
```
